caption:
Slow site = visitors leaving. ⏱️ Three wins that need no coding:

1️⃣ Compress images before you upload
2️⃣ Turn on page caching with a caching plugin
3️⃣ Delete plugins you don't use

Test before and after with a free speed tool. 📌 Save this checklist.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

#wordpress #wordpresstips #websitespeed #webperformance #webdesign #seo #website #pagespeed #techtips #techmendly

scenes.text: Is your WordPress site painfully slow?
scenes.say: Is your WordPress site painfully slow? Three quick wins. No coding.

scenes.title: Compress before you upload
scenes.body: Huge photos are a common slowdown.
scenes.say: One. Compress your images before you upload. Huge photos are a very common slowdown.

scenes.title: Turn on page caching
scenes.body: A caching plugin serves saved pages faster.
scenes.say: Two. Turn on page caching. A caching plugin serves saved pages, so visitors get them faster.

scenes.title: Delete unused plugins
scenes.body: Deactivated is not deleted. Remove what you don't use.
scenes.say: Three. Delete plugins you do not use. Deactivated is not the same as deleted.

scenes.say: Test your site before and after, with a free speed tool, so you can see the difference.
